title: Limited-Time Promotion: Binance Pay Red Packet Giveaway With TRUMP!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are excited to announce a  limited-time double reward promotion  for the Red Packet Giveaway campaign’s Spot and Futures mission. Complete the missions below and get  up to $100 worth of OFFICIAL TRUMP (TRUMP) . Don’t miss out on this opportunity to enhance your crypto journey with Binance! Promotion Period:  2025-01-20 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2025-01-31 23:59:59 (UTC) Missions and Rewards: All Binance Pay users who have  not  made any Spot or Futures trades on Binance  before 2025-01-20 00:00:00 (UTC)  are eligible to participate in this Promotion. Spot Mission: Complete your  first Spot trade  in the Red Packet Giveaway campaign to unlock the following rewards on a  first-come, first-served  basis: Up to  0.02 BNB ;  and Up to  $100 worth of TRUMP Futures Mission: Complete your  first Futures trade  in the Red Packet Giveaway campaign with  a minimum trading amount of $20 equivalent  to unlock the following rewards on a  first-come, first-served  basis: Up to  10 USDC ;  and Up to  $100 worth of TRUMP How to Participate: Step 1:  Log in to the latest version of the  Binance App .  Step 2:  Tap the [Pay] icon in the top-right corner of the homescreen. Step 3:  Select [Red Packet Giveaway] and tap the [Claim] button to receive the free red packet. Step 4:  Scroll down to [Get More Red Packets] and claim the Spot and Futures missions. Step 5:  Complete the Spot and Futures missions for a chance to unlock the limited-time promotion rewards in TRUMP. Terms & Conditions: All Binance Pay users ("Pay Users") who have  not  made any Spot or Futures trades on Binance before 2025-01-20 00:00 (UTC) will be eligible to claim the Red Packet Giveaway’s Spot or Futures Mission rewards. Binance will use the TRUMP/USDC closing price on  2025-01-20  as the exchange rate for rewards distribution. Please note that the actual value of rewards received is subject to change due to market fluctuation. Reward amount will vary, ranging from $0.20 - $100 worth of the applicable crypto token.  Rewards are only eligible to users who have claimed the Spot and/or Future Missions on the Red Packet Giveaway campaign page before completing the mission. Rewards in TRUMP will be credited to eligible users’ Funding Accounts  within 15 days  after the Promotion ends. All eligible users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance Spot/Futures services in each country from which the services are accessed. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants showing any signs of fraudulent behavior immediately (e.g., wash trading, bulk account registrations, self dealing, market manipulation, and more). Binance reserves the right to determine and/or amend or vary these Terms & Conditions, its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the timing or method of any act to be done at any time, with or without notice, for any reason, including, without limitation, for reason of: changes in applicable regulations or policies; obligations arising out of law or decisions issued by common courts or public administration; anti-money laundering or combating financing terrorism rules; technical issues beyond our control; necessity to protect users from potential losses; and necessity to protect Binance from the loss of reputation. Additional promotion terms and conditions apply and can be accessed  here . Tokens referenced in the context of this campaign, are not in any way being recommended, vetted or endorsed by Binance (political or otherwise) and we assume no responsibility or liability for your interaction with these tokens. For more information, see our  Terms of Use ,  Binance Pay Terms of Use , and  Risk Warning and Red Packet Giveaway Campaign T&C .
